title: Eight-bit equal-to comparator

sources.document: AMD Am25LS2521 Eight-Bit Equal-to Comparator (03619B), in AMD 1985 Bipolar Microprocessor Logic and Interface Data Book

pins.name: EIN
pins.text: enable, active low; also the cascade input

functions.formula: /EOUT = NOT(NOT(A0 XOR B0) AND NOT(A1 XOR B1) AND NOT(A2 XOR B2) AND NOT(A3 XOR B3) AND NOT(A4 XOR B4) AND NOT(A5 XOR B5) AND NOT(A6 XOR B6) AND NOT(A7 XOR B7) AND NOT /EIN)
functions.text: /EOUT is low when every A bit equals its B bit and /EIN is low; otherwise high.

electrical.notes: Commercial: VOL 0.45 V max at IOL 8 mA, 0.5 V at 12 mA; VOH 2.7 V min at IOH -440 uA. Input low current: A, B -0.36 mA, /E -0.72 mA. ICC 27 typ / 40 max mA. No internal pull-ups (pages 9-110, 9-111). outputLowMaxCurrentMa is the 8 mA test point; the sheet has no separate recommended IOL.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 2 kohm (A or B input)
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 2 kohm (A or B input)
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 2 kohm
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 2 kohm

notes: Over the commercial range with CL 50 pF the maximums are A/B to /EOUT 20 ns (PLH), 19 ns (PHL); /E to /EOUT 10.5 ns (PLH), 12.5 ns (PHL) (page 9-112). No minimum delays given. On the card two are cascaded: /EOUT of one into /EIN of the next.

behaviour.source: 9-108, 9-109 (PDF pages 945, 946) - AMD Am25LS2521 data sheet, 1985 Bipolar Microprocessor Logic and Interface Data Book
